newsMsgEsr140.message: {P}{bold} Upcoming in the next big release {/bold}: Thunderbird will soon ask you to choose your preferred update path — either the annual ESR track or the faster monthly releases. {ARelease}Learn more about the new release model{/A}.{U} {L}The ESR version will stay on v140, increasing minor version numbers and including only security fixes and bug patches, which is often preferable for corporate environments.{/L} {L}The monthly release cycle will deliver new features and interface updates as they’re developed. Please check whether your current add-ons support this release model. To help with this, you can install the {AcompatCheck}Add-on Compatibility Check{/A}.{/L} {/U}{/P}{P} We're happy to announce that SmartTemplates is fully compatible with Thunderbird 140, the next Extended Support Release (ESR). This means ongoing reliability and peace of mind through the next major support cycle.{/P}{P} SmartTemplates continues to support users on Thunderbird 115 and above for now. Over the coming year, as we add new features, support for Thunderbird 115 may be phased out in favor of Thunderbird 128 and newer.{/P}{P} We continuously monitor Thunderbird changes to ensure SmartTemplates remains compatible and reliable, regardless of the release track you choose.{/P}

newsSection.important.message: {P}{bold}Important:{/bold} Thunderbird continues its monthly release cycle. {/P}{P} Some users may have seen a false incompatibility warning after updating from Thunderbird to v142. This was caused by cached compatibility information in Thunderbird, which sometimes fails to refresh correctly. The previous version of SmartTemplates was already fully compatible with 142. I raised a bug with Thunderbird to fix this: [Bugzilla 1986027]{/P}{P} Rest assured, SmartTemplates fully supports both the monthly and ESR (140.*) channels, and you can continue working without interruption. {/P}

newsSection.intro.message: {P}We continue to follow Thunderbird’s monthly release cycle to ensure compatibility and stability. As always, this work is entirely financed by license sales.{/P}

newsSection.license.message: As all work on SmartTemplates and free support are funded exclusively by license sales, please consider buying a license or renewing your current one.

tags.params.message: A comma delimited list of parameters can be added to modify the output.

tags.plaintext.message: inserts the list of mail tags in plain text, separated by commas.

tags.preset.darkFilled.message: A useful preset for use on dark backgrounds

tags.presets.intro.message: A list of pre-created styles to display tags in a graphical manner.

tags.transform.message: Optional parameters for transforming the text of the tag.

whats-new-intro.message: Read the detailed change log here (English only):

whats-new-list.message: {L}{bold}Maintenance Release 4.18.1:{/bold} Prevent data loss when switching identities mid-composition [issue 415]{P}SmartTemplates now warns before overwriting edited content when changing the sender identity. Push [[{+cancel_button}]] to not load a new template and keep the email body unchanged.{/P}{P}A new option allows appending the correct account signature after cancelling the identity change, avoiding the need to reinsert it manually.{/P}{/L}{L}Import external template menus from another profile [issue 414]{P}Open a smartTemplates.json file from another profile and import the template menu for the selected editing mode ({+new.tab}, {+rsp.tab}, {+fwd.tab}, {+snippets.head}).{/P}{/L}{L}Import members of an address book mailing list from a template using {{%header.set(to,"list:{{listName}}")%}} [issue 411]{P}Resolves all members of the list {{listName}} and assigns their primary email addresses to To, Cc, or Bcc.{/P}{/L}{L}Support relative file paths for {{%attach()%}} [issue 335]{/L}{L}Improved name heuristics from display name "{+names.swap}" [issue 305]{P}Includes a new option "{+names.swap.name}"{/P}{/L}{L}Added documentation for setting variable priority in the Variables window [issue 412]{/L}{L}Modernized icons for the External Templates toolbar{/L}
